text: The path to the virtual environment on disk.

Determines which Python executable to use when creating the virtual
    environment and installing packages. Also the version of Python
    that will be associated with the

, determines the path
    to the Python interpreter to use when creating the virtual environment.

Determines whether the virtual environment should be created with symlinks
    to the source Python binaries. This is recommended on Linux and Mac when
    creating a virtual environment using Houdini’s Python interpreter.

Always fully copy the Python interpreter to the virtual environment,
        instead of creating a symlink.

Create symlinks on Linux and Mac, but copy the interpreter executable
        on Windows.

When on, pip will attempt to use cached packages on the local system
    instead of downloading them every time. This can improve the installation
    times when repeatedly installing the same Python package in different
    virtual environments.
